ev.q: Direct contact with swine prior to illness onset was reported by six patients (five children and one adult)
Of the 11 hospitalized H3N2v patients, case report forms for seven and hospital records for nine were available
Indirect contact with swine during fair attendance was reported by four patients
six of 11 were considered at high risk for influenza complications
Of the hospitalized H3N2v patients described in this report, 10 of 11 were children
As part of the epidemiologic investigation
a total of 106 confirmed H3N2v cases were identified through enhanced surveillance

methods_quotes.q: direct swine contact was defined as touching pigs; indirect swine contact was defined as visiting a swine barn at a fair without touching pigs
collected using a standard CDC human infection with novel influenza A virus case report form, supplemented by review of medical records
* Data gathered from medical chart review.
